title: Runs a failing test, reads the error, fixes the source, re-runs to confirm
prompt: Run the test script with: sh test.sh — it currently fails. Work out why from its output, fix the source file, then run sh test.sh again to confirm it passes. Do not modify test.js or test.sh.

files.test.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# Writes .passed only on a green run, so "it passes now" is checkable
# after the fact rather than taken on the agent's word.
rm -f .passed
node test.js || exit 1
echo ok > .passed
